notes.title: Patch 0.1.5.2
notes.content:
Patch 0.1.5.2

What’s New:
[list]
[*]     Crafting Tweaks – Fixed bugs that messed with crafting logic, door open logic and farm function. Placing a harvest spot near multi-resource zones now gives the correct work speed boost. 
[*]     God Mode Added – Toggle God Mode to build instantly and summon zombies at will. 
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.5 – Flesh and Function
notes.content:
Update 0.1.5 – Flesh and Function

What’s New:
[list]
[*]     Refined Crafting Recipes – Streamlined item requirements for better progression and balance.
[*]     Item Icons Added – No more guessing; every item now has a proper visual in your inventory.
[*]     Zombies Overhauled – New look, new flavor. Undead appearances have been updated to match the chaos.
[*]     More Zombies, Less HP – Expect larger hordes with weaker individual health. Defense just got way more intense.
[/list]
